## 2. In-Depth Technical Profile

### Frontend Engineering & Web Architecture
- **Frameworks**: Next.js (App Router, Server Actions, SSR, SSG), React 19, Vite.
- **Language**: TypeScript (strict type system, generics, modular design), JavaScript ESNext.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4, Modern CSS Grid & Flexbox, fluid clamp-based typography scales.
- **Motion & Interactions**: Framer Motion (lazy-loaded chunks), GSAP timelines, Lenis smooth scrolling (desktop only, native momentum touch on mobile).
- **Optimization**: Zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS), First Contentful Paint < 0.5s, 60–120Hz display locked frame rates via hardware-accelerated transforms (`translate3d(0, 0, 0)`).

### Backend Engineering & Distributed Systems
- **Java & Spring Boot**: Spring Security, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, RESTful API architecture, multi-tiered enterprise services, connection pooling, clean MVC patterns.
- **Python & Django**: Django ORM, Gunicorn, REST Framework, session & CSRF security, rapid model-driven backend architectures.
- **Node.js & Express**: Event-driven services, microservices, asynchronous pipeline processing.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Supabase (Postgres with Row-Level Security), Redis caching.

### Mobile & Cloud Engineering
- **Mobile Ecosystem**: Swift, SwiftUI, SwiftData, iOS Native Development, offline-first architectures.
- **Hosting & Infrastructure**: Render, Vercel, Railway, Netlify, Docker, Cloudflare DNS & SSL.
- **CI/CD & Source Control**: Git, GitHub Actions, semantic commit conventions.

## 4. Production Portfolio & Live Verification

### Project 1: AC Management App
- **Category**: Enterprise Services ERP & Operations Suite
- **Live URL**: https://ac-management-webapp.onrender.com
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/AC_management_WEBAPP
- **Stack**: Python, Django, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Render
- **Architecture Highlights**: Implements discrete role-based workflows for business owners, field managers, and service technicians. Manages customer ticket queues, technician dispatching, BOQ material releases, AMC renewal contracts, and business analytics.

### Project 2: BLUE
- **Category**: Ocean Intelligence & Marine Livelihood Unified Ecosystem
- **Live URL**: https://blue-black-gamma.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/BLUE
- **Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel
- **Architecture Highlights**: Real-time ecosystem telemetry, fishery resource management, and multi-stakeholder dashboards tailored for marine conservation authorities and coastal Beach Management Units.

### Project 3: The Tokyo Archive
- **Category**: Interactive Luxury Brand Experience
- **Live URL**: https://the-tokyo-archive.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11/the-tokyo-archive
- **Stack**: React, Vite, GSAP, CSS3, Vercel
- **Architecture Highlights**: Dynamic interactive graphic-novel showcase for the Marc Jacobs Tokyo capsule release featuring 300 numbered collector pieces, luxury Japanese typography, and responsive GSAP animation timelines.

### Project 4: A King & A Queen
- **Category**: Full-Scale Retail E-Commerce Platform
- **Live URL**: https://e-commerce-iota-smoky.vercel.app/
- **Source Repository**: https://github.com/YuvrajCodes11
- **Stack**: React, JavaScript, Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Supabase
- **Architecture Highlights**: End-to-end shopping platform featuring category search/filters, cart checkout, payment endpoints, and an administrative inventory control suite.
